newsitem.title: UK: NWE heating oil seen well supported in short term.
newsitem.headline: NWE heating oil seen well supported in short term.

text.p: Differentials for prompt Russian heating oil were well supported on Tuesday but some traders said the firmness on spreads might be short-lived.
They saw good buying interest for first half July cargoes following loading delays caused by logistical difficulties at the Latvian Baltic port of Ventspils.
Further support has come from cold weather in parts of the continent, and a small cargo of heating oil moved from Scandinavia into Poland and another within Scandinavia at steady numbers on Tuesday.
But the Ventspils problems are temporary and German demand remains patchy because of warmer weather there, dollar strength against the mark and robust gas oil futures.
IPE July gas oil closed $2.50 a tonne firmer at $167.75.
Two cargoes of Russian heating oil moved into Hamburg at July +$1.50. Low sulphur diesel remains talked around July +$5/6 fob NWE.

Two barges of 0.2 percent heating oil earlier at equivalent to flat and 25 cents above the front month screen. But other traders assessed prompt Rotterdam refinery at 50 cents over the front month, the level at which one barge moved basis Antwerp.
